commercial_building_character: Primarily/largely INDUSTRIAL suburb with very little residential; dominated by factory units and the Woodlands Industrial Estate; also commercial enterprises along Springvale Road. Tiny residential population (25).
source_quotes: Braeside is a suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 25 km south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the City of Kingston local government area. Braeside recorded a population of 25 at the 2021 census.
Braeside is a largely industrial suburb with little residential areas.

The industrial sector of Braeside has been greatly developed in the past thirty years, with the preponderance of development taking place in the mid-1980s, by converting farmland into small or large factory units.
Woodlands Industrial Estate is particularly notable in Braeside.
